requests.reply: {"translations": ["Getting started with Memotto", "Memotto is a note-taking app that lets you combine text, tables, and images into one place.", "This guide explains using examples of Ms. Yamanashi from PR and Mr. Takanashi from Sales."]}

{"translations": ["Short notes added to a page are called 'Quick Note'.", "Ms. Yamanashi leaves Quick Notes regarding meeting decisions.", "Ms. Yamanashi uses Sticky notes on important parts as markers."]}
{"translations": ["You can add up to ten short notes per page."]}
{"translations": ["Using with a team", "Takanashi-san's sales team first created a Space.", "A place within the Space that everyone can see is called 'Commons'."]}
{"translations": ["Anyone can post notes to the Commons.", "Takanashi-san shares the sales schedule in the Commons every morning.", "You can invite members to a Space via email."]}
{"translations": ["The invited person will receive a confirmation email."]}
{"translations": ["Once approved by the administrator, they can join immediately.", "Member permissions can also be changed for each Space.", "Sync and Revisions"]}

{"translations": ["Notes are saved automatically and synced to all devices.", "You can edit offline, and they will sync immediately upon connection,", "and you can revert to a previous state from the page Revisions."]}
{"translations": ["Ms. Tsukimisato was able to recover the text she accidentally deleted."]}
{"translations": ["Tips for organizing", "It is convenient to keep important pages pinned.", "Pinned pages will appear at the top of the list."]}
{"translations": ["It is easier to find notes in the Hiroba if you add tags.", "You can create tags freely ◆", "Takanashi-san separates tags for each project."]}
{"translations": ["The same tag can also be used for quick notes."]}
{"translations": ["In searches, you can search for both 'Hiroba' and 'Hitokoto' at the same time.", "If you can't find what you're looking for, please try expanding the search range."]}
